title: Silgan Dispensing unveils melodie pirouette SNI 13 for molded glass
summary: At LUXE PACK Monaco, Silgan Dispensing is introducing its Melodie Pirouette SNI 13 pump for molded glass, an innovative solution designed to create new growth opportunities in the fragrance market by enabling perfume houses to extend luxury fragrance packaging across a full range of refillable molded glass formats
